'''''CL-5''''' was a [[combat utility vehicle]] launched by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Grey Wolf]]'' during the [[Capture of Ali Tarrak|operation]] to capture [[Nami]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime Lord]] [[Ali Tarrak]]. Its role was to refill Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighters]] with warheads during battle
